notes:
Checks I ran. All 31 quotations are exact in the frozen texts (ctq.py text). Every declaration cited in the draft resolves under its current full name with no rename (resolve.py). The two I add also resolve: Sequences.recurs_not_refutable and World.fixed_iff, and so do the monotonicity and re-identification laws I cite. All 22 record links exist. I read each clause (經) against the Lean hypotheses. I wrote the draft to /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ren-theories/ab4fc732-b2ac-420a-aa49-cf63c999271c/scratchpad/c05review/draft.md and the result to .../c05review/after.md. Every find string occurs exactly once, and all 51 edits apply cleanly.

Substantive errors fixed:
(a) 五·十五 says 物自身之恒不保它对他者无剥. This contradicts 五·十四: a 恒 formation is within renewal at every active step, so it never undermines. The clearer is not 恒, because it consumes the habitat. Only its one depended-on condition is renewed. The draft also claims the clearer meets "every requirement of this 篇", which is false.
(b) 五·七 says the PatternRelay.shifts witness passes at every step. In fact it passes only at odd steps.
(c) 五·十二: 「各自之取在所与之内而共取可以过之」 is not what Flow.joint_excess_ends proves.
(d) 五·十六: the third outcome, restoration, is placed after 终不足, where it is impossible. It belongs after a break.
(e) 五·四: "无损只在两处…藏往" is unproved and wrong, since counting on (succ) is lossless without kept history. The true split is Lossless.unlisted.
(f) Over-strong scope on 「无往不復」, in 五·三 and its 对照 line: infinitely many configurations can also all return. On 「远而必反」, "须" is unproved and revisiting is not returning. 「喪馬勿逐」 omitted finiteness.
(g) 五·三 says "不加任何前提", yet the three laws need finiteness.
(h) Local conditions missing from the text: natural-number levels in revisits_of_bounded, decided identity in continues_as_alike, brief carriers and parts in the 对照 lines. 五·十七 lacked the laws for the monotonicity and re-identification claims. Recurrence is not refutable was cited without its law.
(i) 恒持 was written as kept at every step. Web.Renewed only requires kept at the step of each dependence.

Name fixes:
- 无损 (损 is depletion) becomes 无同归.
- 开 and 开放 for "no list holds it" become 无表尽之. The name table reserves 开 for arising_opens and explicitly forbids it for more_needs_open.
- 合 for merged configurations becomes 同归, because 合 is the merge of formations.
- 合取 was rejected in the table; it is now 共取.
- 合资 and 独资 are financial words.
- 依之者 is not a table name; it becomes 待之者.
- 与于 collides with 与 (giving).
- 续 used for "goes on" collides with 续 (continuation).
- 意义 becomes 顾 in the opening.
- 理 and 复归 in quotations are now marked as different from the adopted names.

Dating: added for 墨经, for the 王弼, 孔疏 and 程朱 commentaries, and for 杂阿含 (Liu Song translation).
Kinds: 迷復 is now labelled 结构类比 like 頻復. 荀子's 竭 is marked as 涸, so the agreement does not rest on the shared character.

Not edited, left to the integrator:
(1) The 經 of 五·六 defines 久 with "体各短或各亡" built in. The spine has no 久 definition, so this is a convention, and the two law sentences already state those conditions. It could be shortened to "兼自某步起每步皆活动".
(2) 维持之物 uses 维持, the modern gloss of 持, for the sustaining formation. Harmless, but 待此所待之物 would avoid the echo.
(3) Several 說 run past eight sentences (五·二, 五·十二, 五·十七, 五·十八).
(4) "所以持续、成功与增长都不证明恒" follows the English chapter. The Lean shows only that persistence fails to certify renewal.
No divergence is written as an agreement. The continuation condition is stated, not asserted, and ordering appears only in 以广为愈.
